milestones.title: The Scoring King
milestones.description: Witnessed LeBron James surpass Kareem Abdul-Jabbar as the NBA all-time leading scorer (38 pts vs OKC).

milestones.title: Historic 50-PT Triple Double
milestones.description: Witnessed Russell Westbrook record his 42nd triple-double of the season with 50 PTS, 16 REB, 10 AST and a game-winning buzzer beater.

milestones.title: World Champions Crowned (Finals G7)
milestones.description: Attended NBA Finals Game 7 to witness basketball championship history (OKC 103, IND 91).

milestones.title: Vegas Lights (NBA Cup Semis)
milestones.description: Attended the In-Season Tournament / NBA Cup Semifinals double-header in Las Vegas.

milestones.title: Western Conference Finals
milestones.description: Attended Western Conference Finals Game 4 (SAS vs OKC).

milestones.title: The Wall at Intuit Dome
milestones.description: Attended multiple games at Steve Ballmer's revolutionary Intuit Dome in Inglewood during its inaugural seasons (5 games attended).

milestones.title: Fifty-Piece Witness
milestones.description: Watched an NBA player explode for 50 or more points in a single live game.

milestones.title: Coast to Coast Hoops
milestones.description: Seen NBA basketball from the Atlantic coast (D.C., Philly, Brooklyn) to the Pacific (Bay Area, LA, Sacramento).

milestones.title: Thunder Faithful
milestones.description: Attended 35 games featuring the Oklahoma City Thunder across multiple eras (Westbrook/George -> SGA/Chet/JDub).

milestones.title: Triple-Double Royalty
milestones.description: Seen 7 triple-doubles live in person by Russell Westbrook, Nikola Jokic, and James Harden.

milestones.title: Down to the Wire
milestones.description: Attended 8 games decided by 3 points or fewer, including 1-point heartstoppers.
